messages:
emily: quick sync — we need a compact contract for per-route SLO panels (P50/P95/P99, TTFT, tokens/sec). I'll propose defaults and ask for objections.

aj: TL;DR: use canonical route label, keep labels low-cardinality, and provide recording rules so Console queries are cheap.

maria: runtime POV: we'll emit histograms for TTFT plus sum/count, and tokens counters. Labels: route_canonical, model, env, region, deployment_id (optional), sample_rate. Keep deployment_id absent for hosted to avoid cardinality.

liam: definition note: TTFT = time from request accept to first token out. Completion latency separate. Important for routing and fast-fail decisions.

sofia: Console UX: dropdowns must hide empty label values (e.g., deployment_id) and show a "show all" toggle. Also show a little "sampled" pill when sample_rate < 1.

jamie: tokens/sec: runtime should emit raw counter redwood_tokens_total. We'll add a recording rule redwood_tokens_per_second = rate(redwood_tokens_total[30s]) so panels are performant.

maria: counters only is my vote. Emitting derived gauges risks inconsistency across restarts and retries.

ingest-bot: emitter v1.2 deployed to staging, sample_rate default 0.5%, TTFT buckets included.

deploy-bot: observability:metrics-emitter v1.2 -> prod rollout 5% started :rocket:

emily: proposed TTFT histogram buckets (seconds): [0.002, 0.01, 0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1, 3, 10]. These are tighter on the low end for fast models.

liam: those low buckets look good. Please also emit _sum and _count for each histogram series for PromQL compatibility.

aj: routing policy label needed: route_routing_policy in {primary,fallback,rate_limited,circuit_breaker}. We'll use it for split panels to show fallback impact.

sofia: for multi-tenant hosted, don't expose absolute quota tokens. Emit percent used redwood_route_quota_percent to avoid leakage.

jamie: add quota_window label to quota metrics (daily/rolling30d) so Console can show appropriate rollups.

emily: Dashboard defaults:
- timeframe: 6h, with 30m sparkline
- top KPIs: P50/P95/P99 TTFT, tokens/sec avg, active inflight
- table view: route_canonical, model, last_6h_P95_TTFT, tokens_per_sec, sample_rate, optional deployment_id column

maria: sample PromQL snippets for docs (please review):
```
# P95 TTFT per route (5m window)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_request_ttft_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le,route_canonical,model,env))

# tokens/sec recording rule
record: redwood_tokens_per_second:avg30s
expr: rate(redwood_tokens_total[30s])
```

liam: add a recording rule for route-level p95 to keep dashboard queries cheap and avoid repeated histogram_quantile work.

aj: alerting suggestion: fire if p95_ttft_route > 1s for >5% of routes for 10m, but suppress if route_routing_policy=circuit_breaker or rate_limited.

sofia: UX: allow grouping by route_routing_policy or model to quickly find regressions after rollouts.

emily: action items and owners:
- eng-runtime (maria): emit histograms, counters, labels; staging PR today.
- eng-platform (liam): add recording rules + cheap p95/p99 metrics.
- console (sofia): dropdown behavior, sample pill, table column toggles.
- observability (jamie): cardinality monitoring and rollout telemetry.

maria: I'll post the emitter PR link once ready.

liam: I'll draft the recording rules and a sample Grafana/Console dashboard JSON.

aj: thanks all. we'll reconvene after PR reviews. if anyone has objections to buckets or labels, flag here before EOD.
